scope: Exact Windows EXE in an isolated profile and desktop. Win32 messages drive the installed menu, battle, Save and Exit, Continue and Escape. The exported Steam script remains installed and original. Only its one-time network initialization was disabled in the two test processes, and the normal offline player entry and save transaction ran after startup. No signed-in Steam account or physical input device participated.
